s: a Polish-seafood restaurant tucked into the park behind Sopot's beach
w: A restaurant built into Park Północny just behind the beach, running for nearly two decades on Polish cooking and a genuine love of the Baltic coast. In summer, hammocks and deck chairs spread onto the restaurant's own patch of private beach, tables looking straight out over the bay.
_facts: Located at ul. Powstańców Warszawy 88, 81-712 Sopot, in Park Północny near beach entrance 7
Established around 18 years ago by Jan Hermanowicz
Serves Polish cuisine, including fresh fish
Summer seating includes a private beach area with hammocks and deck chairs

s: a café in the basement of a pre-war Sopot tenement
w: A café set into the basement of a pre-war tenement building on Królowej Jadwigi, a few streets back from Sopot's beach promenade -- an unpolished, lived-in room with the kind of quiet local following that doesn't need the seafront address to draw a crowd.
_facts: Located at ul. Królowej Jadwigi 7, 81-789 Sopot, Dolny Sopot
Occupies the basement level of a pre-war Sopot tenement building

s: a bright, boho-styled beachfront restaurant with sea views
w: A beachfront restaurant and lounge on Aleja Wojska Polskiego, light-filled and boho-styled, serving seafood, grilled dishes and pizza to a crowd more interested in the sea view than the resort-town scene around it. A relaxed, sleek stop on the Sopot seafront.
_facts: Located at Aleja Wojska Polskiego 1, 81-769 Sopot
Beachfront restaurant and lounge with sea views
Serves seafood, grilled dishes, pizza and cocktails
